description: VARIABLE-APERTURE DWELL as a cognitive_tick-driven graph fixpoint. EFFORT FOLLOWS THE RESIDUAL: after the AbS compare splits a sentence into CONFIRMED (predicted, cheap glide) and SURPRISE (the residual = the news), a DwellStage carrying the residual-derived budget is minted; dw_dispatch dispatches it, and the dwell_advance Reflex consumes ONE unit of the budget per tick (predictive_reading._advance_dwell_stage) -- minting one DeepProcess node (the deep, order-N work) per residual word and marking the stage done when the budget drains. The aperture opens exactly as wide as the residual: a fully-predicted sentence (budget 0) glides in one tick; a high-residual sentence dwells one deep-process tick per surprise word. There is NO Python dwell loop and NO run_rules/fire_reflexes hand-pump -- the reflex advances ONE unit per firing and cognitive_tick drives it. This is the omniglot variable-K dwell scheduler (RUN 11) lifted from stroke shortlists to sentence residuals: attention allocated to unpredictability.

microtheory.name: reading_dwell
microtheory.description: Reading effort is not uniform: the reader GLIDES (cheap confirm) where its model predicts and DWELLS (deep order-N processing) where the residual spikes. The per-sentence dwell budget is the ShapeDecode residual (the surprise), consumed one deep-process step per tick -- so deep-processing effort concentrates on the high-residual sentences (the news), never uniformly.

rules.name: dw_dispatch
rules.comment: Dispatch a DwellStage the moment it is pending (the residual budget is already on it). run_rules dispatches; cognitive_tick's reflex then consumes the budget one unit per tick.
